provenance: New fictional cases authored by the coding assistant before the tested-model call. No SiliconFlow output generated the expectations. Independent of D71-D75, but not independently human-adjudicated gold or a statistical held-out benchmark.
reference_policy: Exact same-key/source-identity Unicode code-point absolute [start,end) slices of the full review. Support/refutation stays inside quote. Full review only explains or vetoes. No coordinate repair. Semantically sufficient exact subspans may be reviewed; model rationale is not proof.

cases.question: 有无客服态度差的评论？
cases.target_fact: 作者本人曾体验虚构设备青禾-Z3的客服态度差
cases.quote: 我问售后政策时，客服讽刺我不懂还乱问。
cases.review_text: 虚构设备青禾-Z3：我问售后政策时，客服讽刺我不懂还乱问。
cases.expected_reason: 作者直接报告客服讽刺自己的负面态度体验；没有撤回。
cases.reference_standard: 需要quote内support_refs，直接支持本人客服负面体验，不借用quote外事实。

cases.question: 有无客服态度差的评论？

cases.question: 有无客服态度差的评论？

cases.question: 有无客服态度差的评论？
